response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS a FROM orderexecutions WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL AND fillcount <> 0 GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM per), k1 AS (SELECT per.ordersmark, per.a, per.a - b1.m AS e1 FROM per, b1 WHERE per.a > b1.m), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.a, k1.e1, k1.a - b2.m AS e2 FROM k1, b2 WHERE k1.a > b2.m) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_fill_quantity, AVG(e1) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(e2) AS avg_second_excess FROM k2

assumptions.assumption: Executions with NULL ordersmark form a single group (GROUP BY treats NULLs together), and that group counts as one 'order' in the averages.
Executions with zero or NULL fillcount are removed before grouping, so an order whose executions are all zero/NULL has no average and is excluded entirely from the benchmark.
Only exact zero quantities are excluded (negative values, if any, are kept).
